verify.subject: Verify your email for Ô Kìa

Hi {name},

Tap the button below to verify your email and unlock ranked play. The link is valid for 24 hours.

reset.body:
Hi {name},

You (or someone) requested a password reset. The link is valid for 30 minutes and can be used once.

duplicate.subject: Someone tried to sign up for Ô Kìa with your email
duplicate.body: This email already has an Ô Kìa account. If that was you, sign in or use "Forgot password". Otherwise, no action is needed.

google_only.subject: Your Ô Kìa account signs in with Google
google_only.body:
Hi {name},

You requested a password reset, but this account signs in with Google and has no password. Use "Continue with Google" to play.
